title: Vathikuchi
desc: Autorickshaw driver Sakthi is head-over-heels in love with his neighbour, Leena. His world spirals into chaos when three ruthless criminals threaten his life.

title: Veerabali
desc: A happy-go-lucky man is forced to adopt violent means to avenge his parents' ruthless murders. So, with the help of his love, he sets out to punish the culprits.

title: Kalvan
desc: Kemban abandons his adopted grandfather in a forest to die at the hands of an animal, so that he would be compensated by the forest department. But the old man keeps surviving, which annoys Kemban.

title: Bhanumathi
desc: Varun, an NRI medical student, and Bhanu, a vivacious, young woman, fall in love with each other. However, they face many personal differences that create complications in their relationship.

title: Taanakkaran
desc: Arivu and his trainee friends face the wrath of a ruthless trainer, Eshwaramurthy, who later plots schemes to demotivate and punish the entire batch.

title: Petromax
desc: Saravanan, an Indian living abroad, struggles to sell his ancestral home in India due to the supposed presence of ghosts in it. He devises a plan to prove that his house is not haunted.

title: Power
desc: Jeetu, a young man, wants to join the force but is discouraged by his brother-in-law, a police officer. A dejected Jeetu steals his uniform and goes around pretending to be an officer of the law.

title: Hello
desc: A man finds and stores the contact number of his lost childhood love in his phone, which is then stolen by a mafia thug. He then sets out to retrieve the cellphone at all costs.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Yuddham Sei
desc: An officer attempts to solve a vital case in his search for his sister. He begins the investigation, unaware of the heinous secrets that await him.

title: Chennai 600028 II: Second Innings
desc: A group of friends reunite for the wedding of one of their own. However, when a mishap threatens to ruin the event, only a series of cricket matches can save the day.

title: Thuppakki Munai
desc: Birla Bose, an encounter specialist, takes on a rape and murder case in Rameswaram. Upon discovering the accused's innocence, he embarks on a quest to uncover the true perpetrators.

title: Ivan Sariyanavan
desc: Gana, a former army officer, embarks on a mission to eradicate corruption leading him to confront a dangerous politician and his oppressive empire.

title: Kaaka Muttai
desc: Two young brothers from a Chennai slum dream of tasting pizza, but their journey to fulfill this simple desire reveals the harsh realities of poverty and social inequality.

title: The Hitlist
desc: A police officer goes after a notorious serial killer who has been targeting his fellow police officers.
